subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.hint: Fetches subtitles by title number; placement reuses the organize pipeline.
subtitles.disabledHint: Enable subtitle fetching and pick at least one source.
subtitles.missingHint: Scraped files without any external subtitle.
subtitles.fetchScope: Picks gaps across the whole library and skips files that already have a subtitle.
subtitles.recentLegend: Missing means the sources have no subtitle for this title; failed means the run could not finish it (no metadata, placement conflict or a transient source error) and the next run retries.
subtitles.libraryHint: With a library selected, the two buttons below only touch it.
subtitles.pointerHint: {{parts}} .strm pointers have no audio; upload subtitles by hand
subtitles.fetchLimitHint: How many files one task may fetch; the server caps it at 500.
subtitles.generationDisabled: Subtitle generation is off in settings, so no transcription task can be submitted.
subtitles.downloadHint: Look up existing Chinese subtitles on subtitlecat / avsubtitles by number; the limit caps how many are filled per run.
subtitles.generateHint: Transcribe with whisper and translate when the sites have nothing; one file takes tens of minutes, so it only runs for the selected library.
subtitles.progressEmpty: No subtitle task is queued or running.

wash.title: Wash
wash.hint: Keeps the best copy per title number and moves the rest to trash, restorable.
wash.disabled: Wash is off; enable it in settings to scan candidates.
wash.confirmApplyMessage: Losing copies move into the trash and can be purged after expiry; the kept copy is untouched. Continue?
wash.confirmRestoreMessage: Selected files move back from the trash; files already at the destination follow the conflict rules. Continue?
wash.confirmPurgeMessage: Only expired records are really deleted; the rest stay. Continue?
wash.confirmApplySelectedMessage_one: Run wash apply on the selected group? The others stay untouched.
wash.confirmApplySelectedMessage_other: Run wash apply on the {{count}} selected groups? The others stay untouched.
wash.purgeNotDue_one: The selected record has not expired yet, so nothing is purged in this round.
wash.purgeNotDue_other: None of the {{count}} selected records has expired yet, so nothing is purged in this round.
wash.purgePartial_one: {{count}} record has not expired yet and is skipped.
wash.purgePartial_other: {{count}} records have not expired yet and are skipped.

maintenance.title: Library maintenance
maintenance.hint: Actions that rewrite files in your libraries live here; each one only previews until you switch it off.

nfo.title: NFO patch
nfo.hint: Add actor thumbnails to NFO files, or drop director lines. Only the files on disk change; indexes and stored metadata stay as they are.

avatar.title: Avatar check
avatar.hint: Sample actor avatars; broken links can be dropped right away.
avatar.note: The check is read-only; only with the switch on does it rewrite avatar URLs. Internal addresses are skipped.

upscale.title: Upscale
upscale.hint: Upscales images below the dimension and size thresholds; the thresholds live in settings, this page only sets how many files are handled per run.
upscale.runFailed: Failed to submit the upscale task
upscale.note: Results appear in Recent results at the bottom of this page.

recent.title: Recent results
recent.running: The task is still running; the result appears once it finishes.

channel.title: Channel
channel.urlMissing: URL is empty, so nothing will be sent.
channel.hint: Webhook receives {"title", "body"}; Bark takes path parameters; Server Chan takes a form; Telegram takes text. Pick digest sections above.

send.title: Send a test message
send.digestHint: The digest is computed server-side over the last seven days; use it to confirm the channel works.

audit.title: Audit
audit.hint: Write operations trail: who changed which path, and when.
audit.confirmClearMessage: This cannot be undone; every recorded write operation is removed.
audit.loadFailed: Failed to load the audit trail
